## Power & standby
toggle  Quick Boot = On [on] -> Turn off <power>
toggle  Stay connected when off = On [on] -> Turn off <power>
toggle  Always Ready = Off [off] -> Turn on <power>
choice  Nightly power-down = 02:00–07:00 -> Move it an hour later {24 values} <power>
toggle  Wake-on-LAN = On [on] -> Turn off <power>
## Timers
choice  Sleep timer = 30 min -> Change {6 values} <timer>
choice  Switch off when idle = Off -> Change {11 values} <settings>
toggle  On Timer = Off (07:00, repeats Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri) [off] -> Turn on <timer>
toggle  Off Timer = 23:30, once [on] -> Turn off <timer>
## Sound and HDMI
== Sound
choice  Sound output = TV speakers -> Change {8 values} <volume>
choice  Sound mode = Standard -> Change {8 values} <volume>
choice  Digital sound output = PCM -> Change {3 values} <volume>
info    Balance = 0 <volume>
toggle  Automatic volume = Off [off] -> Turn on <volume>
toggle  Bluetooth speaker mode = Off [off] -> Turn on <volume>
toggle  eARC = Off [off] -> Turn on <volume>
## Display and devices
== Display
toggle  LG logo = Shown [on] -> Turn off <settings>
== Devices
toggle  SIMPLINK (HDMI-CEC) = On [on] -> Turn off <hdmi>
toggle  Auto power sync = On [on] -> Turn off <power>
toggle  IP control = Off [off] -> Turn on <settings>
toggle  Auto device detection = On [on] -> Turn off <settings>
toggle  Answer device scans on the TV = Off [off] -> Turn on <settings>
== Front lights
toggle  Standby light = On [on] -> Turn off <bulb>
## Power
action  Power off -> Power off (confirms) <power>
action  Reboot -> Reboot (confirms) <power>
